# Load packages
library(survival)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)

# Target genes
target_genes <- c("ENSG00000198840.2", "ENSG00000198763.3")

# Format sample names
colnames(log_expr) <- toupper(substr(colnames(log_expr), 1, 15))
clinical <- clinical %>% mutate(sample = toupper(substr(patient, 1, 15)))

# Expression matrix
expr_df <- as.data.frame(t(log_expr[target_genes, ]))
expr_df <- tibble::rownames_to_column(expr_df, var = "sample")
expr_df$sample <- gsub("\\.", "-", expr_df$sample)

# Convert event
clinical <- clinical %>%
  mutate(event = case_when(
    event == "Dead" ~ 1,
    event == "Alive" ~ 0,
    TRUE ~ as.numeric(event)
  ))

# Remove NA
clinical_clean <- clinical %>% filter(!is.na(survival_time), !is.na(event))

# Match samples
common_samples <- intersect(clinical_clean$sample, expr_df$sample)
cat("✅ Number of matched samples: ", length(common_samples), "\n")

# Subset matched data
clinical_final <- clinical_clean %>% filter(sample %in% common_samples)
expr_final <- expr_df %>% filter(sample %in% common_samples)

# Merge for Cox model
cox_data <- clinical_final %>%
  select(sample, survival_time, event, gender, age_years) %>%
  mutate(gender = factor(gender)) %>%
  left_join(expr_final, by = "sample") %>%
  distinct(sample, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  column_to_rownames("sample") %>%
  na.omit()

# Cox model
cox_model <- coxph(Surv(survival_time, event) ~ gender + age_years +
                     ENSG00000198840.2 + ENSG00000198763.3,
                   data = cox_data)

# Results
summary_cox <- summary(cox_model)
result_table <- summary_cox$coefficients
conf_int <- summary_cox$conf.int

result_table_clean <- data.frame(
  Variable = rownames(result_table),
  HR = conf_int[, "exp(coef)"],
  Lower95CI = conf_int[, "lower .95"],
  Upper95CI = conf_int[, "upper .95"]
)

# Forest plot
ggplot(result_table_clean, aes(x = HR, y = Variable)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, aes(color = HR > 1)) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = Lower95CI, xmax = Upper95CI), height = 0.2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_x_log10(limits = c(0.1, 10)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("blue", "red"), guide = "none") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Cox Model Forest Plot",
       x = "Hazard Ratio (log scale)",
       y = "Variables")
